instructions: Withdraw basic ritual candles and lesser necroplasm at a bank. Combine them in your backpack to make regular ritual candles.
Repeat with the listed supplies; the finished candles are stackable.
Withdraw regular ritual candles and greater necroplasm at a bank. Combine them in your backpack to make greater ritual candles.
Repeat with the listed supplies; the finished candles are stackable.
Withdraw magic incense sticks and infernal ashes. Combine one stick with two infernal ashes to make one infernal magic incense stick.
Bank the finished sticks, refill the supplies and repeat. Quick-cense increases production speed if unlocked.
Equip a usable hatchet and cut the acadia trees west of Het's Oasis. Bank the logs when you need more backpack space, then return to the trees.

Anachronia: For a first visit, board The Stormbreaker on the river east of the Varrock Dig Site and complete the arrival tutorial.
After the tutorial, build and activate the Anachronia lodestone at Base Camp for future visits.
Elder Halls: After completing Fate of the Gods, use the World Gate set to Freneskae to reach the Elder Halls. The elder divination outfit can also teleport to the elder wisp colony.
Grotworm Lair: Use the Port Sarim lodestone, then go north-west and enter the eastern cave entrance. The Queen Black Dragon is at the bottom of the lair, behind a portal requiring 60 Summoning.
Cooks' Guild: The Cooks' Guild is just west of Varrock; a skills necklace can teleport to its entrance. Entry requires 32 Cooking and a chef's hat or sous chef's toque; members can use a Cooking cape or max cape instead. Completing hard Varrock achievements also removes the headgear requirement.
Mount Firewake: Use the World Gate after completing Ritual of the Mahjarrat and Fate of the Gods to access Mount Firewake on Kethsi.
Orthen Oubliette: Reach Anachronia first. Raksha's lair is south-west of Laniakea in the south-eastern part of the island, beneath the Anachronia Swamp Fortress.
Monastery of Ascension: Use the Oo'glog lodestone and head west into the Feldip Hills to the Monastery of Ascension.
Slayer Tower Mausoleum: The mausoleum is beneath the Slayer Tower in Morytania. It is also accessible from the Myreque memorial north of Canifis.
Falador Mole Lair: Go to Falador Park in northern Falador and enter the plant roots to descend into the mole lair beneath the city.
Temple of Isolation: The temple is accessible during and after Beneath Scabaras' Sands. Go into the Scabarite Cavern outside Pollnivneach and use the old boat to reach the temple.
Mourner Tunnels: The tunnels are under the Mourner Headquarters in north-east West Ardougne. Start Mourning's End Part I and wear a Mourner outfit to enter the first part. The dark-beast section requires starting Mourning's End Part II and obtaining the new key.
Fight Arena south-east mine: The mine is between Port Khazard and Yanille. Use the Yanille lodestone and run north-east, or take a charter ship to Port Khazard and run south.
Ungael ritual site: After completing Rune Mythos and Requiem for a Dragon, use Ungael Teleport to reach the ritual site. To use the site after the quest, speak to the Archivist while wearing Zorgoth's ring.
Lumbridge Catacombs: Use the Lumbridge lodestone, then go to the catacombs entrance in Lumbridge cemetery. Complete The Blood Pact to access the lower level.
The Gate of Elidinis: Complete Ode of the Devourer to access the boss. Go to the northern docks in the City of Um and take the gondola next to the Suspicious Stranger's former position; the Gate is above the Sanctum of Rebirth.
Player-owned house: Use a house portal you can access, the House Teleport spell at 40 Magic, or a teleport-to-house tablet. The current housing system starts with There's No Place Like Home... in Rimmington. This method also needs a usable larder setup in the house.
